newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone issues coins to ease transactions.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone issues coins to ease transactions.

text.p: Sierra Leone issued brand new coins in three denominations on Monday to solve an acute problem of change in the West African country.

Finance Minister Thaimu Bangura said Dutch-minted coins in 10, 50 and 100 leones "would solve the problem of supplying the nation, not only with the required volume of currency but also with the right denominations."
He said he had personally witnessed wrangles between passengers and taxi drivers and between market women and their customers over change.

"The small notes and coins, which should normally perform the change function, are either not available or are in such deplorable condition that even beggars are loath to accept them as alms," Bangura said at an official ceremony.
